baseline_models.focus_anchor: The paired conditionals repeat حسن and reuse سوء, while لأنفسكم and فلها direct both consequences back to the addressed selves.
baseline_models.mechanism: Good action recursively accrues to the actor; bad action returns likewise, and the second سوء occurrence externalizes that return on the face.

activation_trace.role: The repeated causative action supplies deliberate beneficence as both input and self-directed yield.
Self as the actor's own identity makes the beneficiary and liability holder coincide.
Harm links the initial wrongdoing to the later making-bad of the face, closing the return circuit.

changed_reading.before: Good helps the doer and evil harms the doer.
changed_reading.after: Conduct is a reflexive circuit: the deed accrues to the self, and evil later becomes publicly legible on that same collective self.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The latter promise arrives, and the entry is explicitly compared with a first occurrence.
baseline_models.mechanism: A bounded appointment materializes as a replay: latter and first distinguish turns, while the doubled دخول and temporal مرة make the prior incursion a reusable pattern.

activation_trace.role: Arrival turns the announced event from latent commitment into present occurrence.
A bounded appointment supplies the temporal threshold that releases the sequence.
Lateness distinguishes this turn from an earlier counterpart without erasing their relation.
The repeated ingress verb makes penetration of the interior the event copied across turns.
The first occurrence supplies the template against which the latter entry is recognized.
An occurrence counted in time converts similarity into recurrence.

changed_reading.before: A promised enemy attack happens again.
changed_reading.after: The latter promise is an appointed replay: arrival reopens a prior ingress pattern, so history is structured as repeatable turns rather than an isolated raid.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Three purpose clauses move from faces, to entry into the mosque, to destroying whatever the entrants overtop.
baseline_models.mechanism: Damage advances by depth and scale: it first marks the visible front, then breaches the ritual interior, then dismantles the order brought under domination.

activation_trace.role: The visible front of the person is the first site on which the consequence appears.
Ingress carries the action from exposed surface into a bounded interior.
The prayer-place makes the breached interior communal and sacred rather than merely architectural.
Overtaking and domination define the full reach of what becomes exposed to destruction.
Intensive breaking and nullification make the terminal phase structural rather than momentary.

changed_reading.before: Attackers humiliate people, enter the mosque, and destroy possessions.
changed_reading.after: The punishment advances by depth: public countenance is spoiled, sacred interior is breached, and the attained upper order is dismantled.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Faces are made bad immediately before elevated dominance is subjected to intensive destruction.
baseline_models.mechanism: Moral defect becomes public discredit: the wrongdoing root returns as marked disgrace, while faces as bearers of standing and domineering elevation are reversed together.

activation_trace.role: Making defective and blameworthy translates prior wrongdoing into an exposed mark.
Face as public standing lets bodily humiliation also register as loss of rank and leadership.
Domineering elevation supplies the high social order exposed to reversal.
Thorough nullification converts discredit into the collapse of elevated power.

changed_reading.before: Their faces are physically grieved or disfigured before material destruction.
changed_reading.after: The sequence can also stage a political reversal: public standing is disgraced before an order built on overbearing elevation is undone.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus is the hinge of an explicit two-turn feedback loop: loss of order triggers an appointed incursion, restored capacity reopens agency, and renewed return can meet either mercy or renewed response.

activation_trace.role: The latter appointment is the threshold at which accumulated conduct becomes an event.
Reference to the first occurrence keeps the present turn inside a repeated series.
Departure from sound order names the recurrent state that initiates both turns.
Restoration of the counterturn interrupts defeat and proves that the communal state can reverse.
Merciful tenderness keeps a restorative outcome open after punishment.
Paired return after departure makes renewed conduct elicit renewed response.

structural_cues: 17:4 announces two occurrences; 17:5 fulfills the first promise; 17:7 names the latter and repeats the first entry.
17:6 restores the turn and resources, while 17:8 pairs return with return and leaves mercy possible.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies explicit two, first, latter, restoration, and paired-return markers plus a mercy branch; I infer a conduct-response feedback loop in which communal state changes the next turn. A live alternative is a closed historical chronology with no reusable mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The ayah states individual moral reciprocity and then reports a second invasion.
changed_reading.after: The moral conditional is the control rule of a communal cycle: conduct changes the group's condition, the appointed response arrives, recovery restores agency, and recurrence remains conditional rather than fatalistic.

context_deltas.mechanism: Guidance directs intentional work toward uprightness and repair, whose reward returns to its makers; حسن therefore becomes self-building alignment rather than an unspecified pleasant deed.

activation_trace.role: Deliberate beneficence anchors the focus side of a constructive action sequence.
Gentle direction toward a true path supplies orientation before action.
Straightness and balanced standing define the order toward which guidance aims.
Purposive work turns orientation into enacted construction.
Soundness opposed to corruption identifies the work's restorative product.
Return for work completes the constructive circuit back to the actors.

structural_cues: 17:9 links guidance, the most upright course, intentional sound works, and a large return in one chain.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an orientation-work-soundness-return chain; I map that chain onto the focus's repeated حسن and its benefit to the self. The live alternative is that 17:9 only states a neighboring reward proposition and does not specify حسن.

changed_reading.after: Doing good is self-repair through guided, intentional alignment: it builds the sound order and capacity that corruption later places at risk.

context_deltas.mechanism: Haste can put the same desiring or calling force behind opposite outcomes, so the focus's good and bad poles cannot be reduced to what the actor urgently names or wants.

activation_trace.role: Deliberate good action supplies one pole whose identity initially appears self-evident.
Badness and defect supply the opposed pole and its adverse yield.
A call capable of bringing an unwelcome outcome gives desire a self-harming causal route.
Explicit evil occupies the object slot of the same calling pattern used for good.
Desired benefit supplies the comparison pole that makes the inversion visible.
Premature acceleration explains how desire can outrun discrimination between the two outcomes.

structural_cues: 17:11 places evil and good after parallel calling constructions and closes by characterizing the human as hasty.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies syntactic equivalence between calling for evil and good plus haste; I infer that haste can corrupt an actor's classification of what benefits the self. A live alternative confines the warning to impulsive speech rather than moral discernment generally.

changed_reading.before: The actor knows which deeds are good and which are bad, and each produces its matching consequence.
changed_reading.after: The consequence rule remains stable, but human labeling is unstable: urgency may pursue harm under the felt form of benefit, so desire is not the measure of حسن.

context_deltas.mechanism: Acts become entries attached to the acting self: the record adheres, the self reckons it, and its burden cannot migrate to another bearer.

activation_trace.role: The actor's own identity anchors both benefit and liability in the focus.
Binding a judgment to its subject supplies the attachment rule for the personal record.
The self as one's very identity becomes sufficient witness to its own account.
Counting and reckoning convert accumulated conduct into an inspectable account.
The repeated benefit-to-self construction directly echoes and sharpens the focus.
A heavy load assigned to its bearer supplies the nontransferability of adverse consequence.

structural_cues: 17:13 fastens a record to each person, and 17:14 makes the self sufficient as reckoner.
17:15 repeats benefit to one's own self and liability upon it, then bars one bearer from carrying another's burden.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies attachment, self-reckoning, a near-exact self-benefit/self-liability echo, and nontransferable burden; I infer a personal ledger joining them. A live alternative reads the focus only as immediate psychosocial consequence without a stored account.

changed_reading.before: Good and evil rebound upon their doers.
changed_reading.after: Every deed posts to a self-held, nontransferable account: the same self receives the gain, bears the load, and ultimately reads the record.

context_deltas.mechanism: Counted time, the contrast between immediate and latter aims, purposeful striving, and graded outcomes let the focus's latter promise retain its second-event sense while also opening a delayed moral horizon.

activation_trace.role: A fixed time capable of recurrence makes the promise legible as a scheduled moral threshold.
What comes after the first supplies both sequence and semantic openness toward a later horizon.
Enumeration turns passing years into measurable intervals rather than undifferentiated delay.
Acceleration and bringing forward define the immediate horizon against which later consequence is read.
The explicit later aim reactivates the focus term beyond the local first-versus-second pairing.
Purposeful movement toward an aim links delayed outcome to sustained agency.
Stepwise levels make the later result differentiated rather than a single undivided endpoint.

structural_cues: 17:12 makes day and night signs for counting years and reckoning.
17:18 and 17:19 oppose the immediate aim to the latter aim, and 17:21 describes the latter in larger degrees.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies counted time, an explicit immediate/latter contrast, striving, and degrees; I allow that later semantic horizon to resonate in 17:7 while preserving the local second-incursion sense. A live alternative keeps 17:7's term exclusively ordinal.

changed_reading.before: The latter promise means only the second of two historical incursions.
changed_reading.after: The second incursion remains primary, but it also becomes a near-field instance of delayed moral accounting: immediate choices mature across counted time into differentiated latter outcomes.

context_deltas.mechanism: Expansive privilege releases boundary-breaking conduct inside a settlement; fixed liability and total demolition follow, making the invaders' destruction the terminal phase of an internally compromised order.

activation_trace.role: Overbearing elevation identifies the kind of high order whose own posture helps expose it to reversal.
Intensive nullification is the visible terminal operation performed on that order.
Falling into extinction supplies the endpoint toward which the settlement sequence moves.
Abundance that releases its possessor supplies the internal social condition preceding breach.
Emergence outside a containing skin gives the transgression a boundary-breaking material image.
Extirpating ruin confirms that the endpoint is systemic removal, not a limited setback.
Culpability ties repeated generational destruction back to the inhabitants' own conduct.

structural_cues: 17:16 sequences privileged actors, their breach, fixed liability, and intensive demolition inside one settlement.
17:17 broadens destruction across generations and explicitly joins it to culpability.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the internal sequence from privilege through breach to demolition and then generalizes destruction by culpability; I infer that external unmaking executes the collapse of an already compromised order. A live alternative treats the sequence only juridically, without an endogenous social mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Enemy forces destroy whatever they manage to overrun.
changed_reading.after: Their destructive entry is the terminal unmaking of an order destabilized from within: expansive privilege breaks containment, domineering height becomes vulnerable, and external force completes the collapse.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it links the focus to the distant opening movement rather than only to the immediate historical sequence. It remains anchored by repeated mosque-space, directed movement, entry, seeing, and faces; downstream prose should present it as a compositional reversal, not as a claim that the two journeys are lexically equivalent.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The hostile agents enter the mosque and alter faces, while the opening context moves a servant between mosque-spaces in order to be shown signs.

activation_trace.role: The communal prayer-place is the shared spatial anchor across the two movements.
Hostile ingress turns access to sacred interior into penetration.
The exposed face lets the later movement terminate in public visibility and injury.
Directed night travel supplies the opening's protected sacred transit.
Two prayer-places frame movement as passage within a sacred spatial relation.
Being shown signs gives the opening transit a revelatory visual end opposed to later facial exposure.

changed_reading.before: The focus reports a repeated hostile entry into a mosque and humiliation of faces.
changed_reading.after: Against the opening sacred passage toward seeing signs, the later entry reads as reversed transit: access becomes penetration, and revelatory seeing becomes exposed, injured countenance.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because it activates a split mapped root's alternating annual yield rather than the dominant promise sense. It remains anchored by the paired conditionals and the first/latter recurrence markers; downstream prose should qualify it as a temporal-material analogy, never as a replacement translation for وعد.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The two moral conditions precede a latter appointment explicitly patterned on a first occurrence.

activation_trace.role: Alternating productive and fallow years supply an image for conduct yielding opposite communal seasons.
A counted time that comes around again supplies the clock for alternation.
The latter phase marks the second side of the alternating pattern.
The first phase supplies the prior season to which the later one answers.
Counted occurrence keeps the analogy periodic rather than merely oppositional.

changed_reading.before: Good and evil produce consequences, followed by the second promised incursion.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the ayah resembles an alternating-yield clock: collective conduct bears one season, lapses into another, and the counted turn returns with its corresponding fruit.

strongest_changes: The focus became the hinge of an explicit conduct-response cycle rather than a detached maxim followed by a raid.
The self-directed clauses became a nontransferable ledger through the attached record, self-reckoning, and burden syntax of 17:13-15.
The good-and-bad polarity became epistemically unstable under haste: desired benefit can be misidentified even though the consequence rule remains stable.
The latter promise retained its second-incursion sense while also resonating with counted time, delayed striving, and graded latter outcomes.
summary.what_was_special: The same سوء root joins prior wrongdoing to later facial injury, while the purpose clauses move from visible face through sacred interior to dominated height. Context then supplies unusually exact return, self-accounting, and immediate-versus-latter mechanisms instead of merely thematic parallels.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether faces primarily denote bodily grief or disfigurement, public standing, leading persons, or several of these at once.
Whether the later horizon activated by 17:18-21 should remain a resonance or materially govern the focus's ordinal use.
Whether ما علوا centers what the entrants physically overtop, the power they dominate, or an already elevated social order.
Whether the alternating-yield split-root activation is productive enough for downstream prose or should remain trace-only.
